readme: Facts the Autodesk App Store package needs that only the publisher can supply. tools/build_store_package.py reads this file. supportEmail is required by the store for a download (CompanyDetails Email): it must be an address that is monitored. tools/build_store_package.py --submission fails while it is empty.
